safety_and_contract_guarantees.concurrency_exclusion: PostgreSQL canary_receipts_active_single_row unique partial index enforces single concurrent runner
safety_and_contract_guarantees.retry_disabled: Strands Agent retry_strategy is explicitly None, preventing automatic retry on 429 or invalid output
safety_and_contract_guarantees.cancellation_safety: asyncio.CancelledError transitions receipt to UNCERTAIN with CANCELLED failure code, retaining concurrency_active=True
safety_and_contract_guarantees.cleanup_guarantee: GroqModel.aclose() and TransportObserver.aclose() invoked in all finally branches
safety_and_contract_guarantees.secret_protection: TransportObserver only records send_index, wire_byte_length, and status_code; headers, payloads, and tokens are never stored
safety_and_contract_guarantees.token_accounting: actual_total_tokens remains None/NULL; reserved_output_tokens is capped at 6144 (6 sends * 1024 tokens)
